supplemental_items.interpretation: Select raw opposite points and final resolved main points: bullish highs native/lows final; otherwise highs final/lows native. Main row lookup keys are exact pairs (local source index, serialized source epoch); dictionary construction is last-row-wins for repeated keys. Main-row cycleIds use original main points, short-circuit exact source index, exact epoch, decision<=end and non-null cycle id; stable first-occurrence deduplication follows transformed ids. Cycle rows retain visible cycle order and require non-null id. highCount always invokes selected(cycle.highs); bullish lowCount similarly serializes selected lows, but nonbullish lowCount counts already-selected low rows by cycleId equality. Main-side lowIds/highIds use original cycle points with decision<=end and existing key membership; dedup by resulting row id in encounter order, not an independent sort. Trigger fields distinguish main timestamp and exact event. No new trading decision or implicit symmetry correction.
